name: Puzzle de Maid
source:
Main character is lost in a forest. He encounters three maids who claim that hero can't leave the forest till he passes through all their challenges

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在森林中迷路了。他遇到了三个女仆，她们声称主人公在通过她们所有的挑战之前无法离开森林。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
